# AWS Migration and Modernization

Migration skills for the main agent: AWS Transform modernization (.NET, mainframe, VMware, SQL Server, language and SDK upgrades) and DMS Schema Conversion for heterogeneous database migrations.

## How it works

This is a **vertical plugin**: its skills, commands, and MCP servers attach directly to your main agent, with no sub-agent hand-off. Prefer the [`aws-modernization-agent`](../../agent-plugins/aws-modernization-agent) agent plugin when you want an isolated specialist instead.

- Install: `claude plugin install aws-migration@talkops-devops-plugins`
- Skills activate from their descriptions; invoke one explicitly with `/aws-migration:<skill>`

## Skills

| Skill | What it does |
|---|---|
| `aws-transform` | Migrate, modernize, and upgrade codebases to AWS. |
| `dms-schema-conversion` | Handles the full DMS Schema Conversion lifecycle including creating migration projects, converting database schemas to a target engine, running compatibility assessments, navigating metadata trees, exporting converted D… |

## Commands

| Command | Description |
|---|---|
| `/aws-migration:assess` | Assess a codebase or estate for modernization with AWS Transform |
| `/aws-migration:convert-schema` | Convert a database schema with DMS Schema Conversion |

## MCP servers

Declared in [`.mcp.json`](./.mcp.json); started when the plugin is enabled and available to the main agent.

| Server | Transport | Launch | Tool names | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `aws-mcp` | stdio | `uvx mcp-proxy-for-aws-cli==1.7.0` `--skip-auth --metadata` | `mcp__plugin_aws-migration_aws-mcp__*` | Managed AWS MCP Server via the toolkit's pinned proxy (aws___call_aws, aws___search_documentation, aws___retrieve_skill, ...). |
| `aws-transform-mcp` | stdio | `uvx awslabs.aws-transform-mcp-server@latest` | `mcp__plugin_aws-migration_aws-transform-mcp__*` |  |

AWS credentials are inherited from the host environment (`AWS_PROFILE`, SSO, or instance role). `AWS_REGION` defaults to `us-east-1` when unset. Toggle any server off per project in `/mcp`.
